openState.question: does a disclosure a reader opened survive a repaint
openState.answer: not applicable on this face, and here is the mechanism rather than the assurance
openState.mechanism: mount() paints exactly twice and never again: once with the waiting screen, once when the two reads answer. This face declares no acts, holds no state a control can change, and has nothing that asks for a redraw -- the only thing a reader can do to this screen is fold one of the two disclosures, which the browser does in place. Nothing rebuilds the tree, so there is no repaint for an open state to be lost to.
